name: Roisin Dubh
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Roisin Dubh, also called Dark Rose, is a woman of Irish folklore. In Aisling verse her name marks a dark-haired maiden. She walks the roads by herself. She looks for a king with the strength to undo her chains. She stands as a later version of Sovereignty, the old goddess who watched over the Land.
